new_native_experiment_launches: paused after in-flight query V2 batch; require an explicit diagnostic hypothesis and a bounded predeclared comparison before next launch
objective_order: net native input and output savings

candidates.status: one positive paired task; requires independent confirmation
promising single pair, large observed control variation; requires repeated controls
positive development observations, no independent holdout

composition.requirement: Test selected model/task policy jointly with exact retrieval and source-copy only where the actual task requires them.
composition.no_arithmetic_shortcut: Do not add or multiply percentages from different pairs. Features may remove the same cost or add verification and retrieval work.
composition.measurement: Compare complete joint episodes against the same efficient baseline, including all preparation, fallback, failed attempts and required validation.
composition.routing_cost: Deterministic model ID plus explicit task type; no extra LLM router. Charge classification and ambiguous-case fallback to total costs.
composition.quality: Any observed regression rejects the candidate for that scope. Finite no-failure results do not prove zero intelligence loss.

next_experiment_gate: Finish offline trace attribution and baseline variability analysis first.
State which measured cost the change removes and what observation falsifies that hypothesis.
Freeze candidate policies before fresh task variants and checker release; exclude held-out answers from agent-accessible state.
Use balanced candidate/control order and matched variants; retain all results, not only best pairs.
Within each selected model/task scope compare ordinary, selected mechanism, and joint mechanism; omit irrelevant arms by predeclared criteria.
Set native-call and token budgets and a stop rule before launch; avoid automatic full matrices for every local code change.
Publish per-model and task Q/A/W checks, input and output separately, confidence limits, and complete known costs.
